subject: History
notes: Syllabus for exams in 2027–2028. Option B core content: the 20th century, international relations since 1919 (six key questions). Depth studies: Germany 1918–45, Russia 1905–41, the USA 1919–41. Papers: Paper 1 structured questions (core and depth studies), Paper 2 document (source) questions, and either Component 3 coursework or Paper 4 (alternative to coursework) on a depth study. Level-based mark schemes reward explained, well-supported points and, in 'how far' questions, a balanced argument with a justified judgement.
